title: Linear-depletion rate-drift: per-interaction full-window re-spread leaves active stakers under-earning (~63.26% delivered) and the budget never depletes
description: NFTStakerDepletion's linear-depletion reward schedule re-spreads the entire remaining budget across a fresh full window on every interaction (_recomputeSchedule / _syncBudget). Because each interaction restarts the depletion window, the emission rate is repeatedly recomputed against a horizon that never finishes elapsing, so the budget is asymptotically re-deferred rather than paid down. Over the intended schedule active stakers receive only ~63.26% of what the linear-depletion model should deliver (an ~37% shortfall), and the budget never fully depletes. This is the same per-interaction full-window re-spread root cause class as the phlimbo Linear-Depletion bug.
impact: Active stakers under-earn by ~37% (only ~63.26% of the intended emission is delivered) and the reward budget never depletes to zero, leaving value permanently undistributed. No principal is at risk and the solvency invariant holds throughout — payouts remain bounded by the funded balance. The harm is a protocol-function / value-delivery deviation (rewards do not match the linear-depletion spec), not insolvency or theft.
attackPath: No attacker — this is a structural accounting drift triggered by ordinary staker activity.
1. _recomputeSchedule re-spreads the full remaining budget across a fresh full depletion window on every interaction.
2. Each stake/unstake/claim interaction restarts the window, so the depletion horizon never fully elapses.
3. The emission rate is recomputed against the perpetually-restarted horizon, asymptotically re-deferring the budget.
4. Result: active stakers receive only ~63.26% of the intended linear-depletion emission (~37% shortfall) and the budget never depletes.
recommendation: Anchor the depletion schedule to a fixed start/end window so the remaining budget is spread over the remaining (not a fresh full) window on each recompute, rather than restarting the full window per interaction. The rate must integrate against elapsed time so that, in the limit, the full budget is delivered on the intended schedule.

triage.note: Owner-acknowledged 2026-06-25, will-fix. AGREED CLARIFICATION: a non-zero `pull` inflow = a new NFT minted = genuine budget increase, so restarting the depletion window (windowEnd = now + windowSeconds) on a real inflow is INTENDED and is being kept; the fix only stops the window/rate recompute on interactions that did NOT change the budget. Fix plan: (1) gate the `_syncBudget` recompute on inflow > 0 (move `_recomputeSchedule()` inside the `if (inflow > 0)` block; drop the unconditional and no-hook-branch recomputes); (2) remove the vestigial stake/unstake tail recomputes at L565/L585 (rate is totalStaked-independent — they only reset the deadline); (3) leave `_updatePool` per-interaction and the config-setter recomputes untouched. SPECIFIC TO NFTStakerDepletion — must NOT be mirrored into NFTStaker / NFTStakerPriceScaled (budget-independent APY/runway model where per-interaction recompute is correct). Authoritative human triage — do not auto-overwrite.
